verses.author: model_A
verses.text: A boat leaves the harbor before anyone is awake to see it go.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
wake ripples out
touching every anchored hull—
none of them notice

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the fisherman wakes
counts his nets, not the water,
never asks what passed

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
something unseen
already changed the current
before he cast the line

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the horizon holds
no trace of where it went—
gulls circle anyway

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
they wait for a return
that already came and left

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
he sorts the empty shells
keeping the one that still hums
with the shape of the wave

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the tide leaves its ledger
in wet sand—
he reads it with his feet
